_doc: Settlement markers from THE BEAR & THE BULL, Western United States in the year 2281. Positions are mechanical - peak correlation against the sheet's own printed legend glyphs - and projected through bear-and-bull-2281-georef.json. The NAMES were read by eye; a marker whose label could not be resolved carries name: null.
creatorNote: OPEN CREDIT GAP - unidentified, deliberately not researched
licence: None stated on the sheet. Staged in-repository; publication is the owner's act.

sheetVersusRealPlacesKm.measuredAgainst: public coordinates of places whose referent is uncontested
sheetVersusRealPlacesKm.whatItIncludes: the sheet's registration AND the author's own hand placing each marker by eye. It cannot separate them, and it is the error a reader of these points actually experiences.

provenance.permits: point sites, capitals, containment, names attached to regions
